rubric.harvestable: 0-20 measured. Of the pages the harvest would take (first 5 project pages, or 3 articles for a feed), the share that return 4 or more photos.
rubric.photo_size: 0-20 measured. Share of sampled photos that pass the build gate (1080 x 1350 after the 4:5 crop).
rubric.hospitality: 0-15 measured. Share of those pages (or feed items) about a hotel, bar, restaurant, club, bath or cafe.
rubric.volume: 0-10 measured. Project links (30 or more = 10) or feed items (10 or more = 10) available.
rubric.lens: 0-15 judgment. Fit with the lens: era feel, rooms to be in, classics supply.
rubric.mix: 0-10 judgment. What it adds to the source mix: classics supply 10, venue or restoration side 8, photographer or studio originals 7, press with its own shoots 5, press echo 3.
rubric.rule: Unreachable, wrong site, or nothing harvestable = not suitable, dropped before ranking. The top 30 suitable candidates are ranked; the bottom 5 are killed; 25 are added.
